mission: Torin makes the best possible case for the technique while the Codex material explains what the wound actually is and why it will not heal on its own.
why_now: The Codex's heresy is now on the table. With the technique named at R04b and the wound's mechanism specified here, the chain that links Veraine's procedure to Veranthos is legible in outline for the first time. Sera's warning in the corridor lands because Ben has just understood -- in his body -- the scale of what Torin's reading is trying to justify.
conflict: Torin's reading of the Codex is intellectually beautiful. If Ankhural's heresy is right, the technique is correction rather than violation. The argument is seductive in proportion to how well it fits the evidence -- and the evidence, just revealed by R04c, is worse than Ben had let himself understand. In the same archive material, Veraine's clinical annotation about pressure, drainage, and scar geometry lands without ideology, introducing her working mind before her person arrives. Ben's susceptibility is the warning, not his speech.
turning_point: Ben catches the motion of his own head nodding to Torin's last sentence. He stops it. Sera sees him catch it, and pulls him aside.
opening_hook: Torin holds the Codex fragment and doesn't flinch. Everyone else did
closing_hook: Sera, very quietly to Ben, names the argument's lineage without naming Gavran — she has heard this one before, from a man she followed into a war. She doesn't say the name. She doesn't need to
emotional_trajectory: Absorbing the wound's mechanism -> intellectual engagement with Torin's reading -> seductive logic -> Sera's cold water

stakes.personal: Ben nearly seduced by Torin's interpretation — a warning about his own susceptibility, sharpened by the fact that he has just understood what the wound actually costs
stakes.interpersonal: Sera trusting Ben enough to name Gavran in the same breath as Torin, even without the name
stakes.external: Torin's relationship with the technique is deepening; the wound's architecture is legible as a sustained human cost

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — common area, then private corridor exchange
sensory_details: The Codex's records resolving into wound-mechanics — the anchor system as an engineered architecture, not a containment field; Torin's Force presence when he holds the Codex — the heaviness lifting into something lighter and more dangerous; Sera's jaw tight; Kael's expression saying without saying that both positions prove his point; Ben's understanding of the mechanism landing in his stomach a beat before it lands in his head
canon_elements_needed: Force wound theory with Nihilus and Malachor V precedent
Anchor system architecture — Force-sensitives used as structural load-bearing in a sealed wound
Jedi Lords era containment engineering; twelve-anchor configuration rationale
action_beats: Torin lifts the Codex fragment and holds it steady while the others watch for a reaction that doesn't come

Torin's reading of the same material lands as correction-not-violation — coherent, beautiful, dangerous

notes: The danger here is seduction. Ben should almost agree, and Sera's warning should land because she can hear the old pattern returning.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Ben catches the motion of his own head nodding to Torin's final argument.
turning_point_detail.shift: He stops the nod mid-motion. Sera sees him catch himself and pulls him aside into the corridor.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben's susceptibility to Torin's logic is exposed — a warning about his own capacity for rationalization when confronted with intellectually coherent justification for a dangerous act. The cost to Sera is the strain of trusting Ben enough to name Gavran's pattern without naming Gavran, risking that Ben will not hear the warning.

emotional_arc.start: Absorbing the wound's mechanism — understanding landing in Ben's stomach before it lands in his head, visceral before intellectual.
emotional_arc.shift: Intellectual engagement with Torin's reading deepens into seductive logic — the argument is coherent, beautiful, and dangerous in proportion to how well it fits the evidence Ben has just internalized.
emotional_arc.end: Sera's cold water — the recognition that he was nearly nodding agreement, and the historical echo of that pattern in a man he knows Sera followed into catastrophe.

key_beats.beat_description: Torin lifts the Codex fragment and holds it steady. The others watch for a flinch that doesn't come.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract pressure of the seal's failure becomes concrete — the artifact is present, the records are legible, the mechanism is about to be named.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's instinct pushes toward action rather than explanation; the weight of the wound's mechanism registers through his body as a physical pressure before his mind processes what he's seeing. His breath tightens. His hand moves toward the table, then stops.

key_beats.beat_description: The fragment's records resolve — the wound's mechanism named, the anchor system specified, twelve living Force-sensitives as sustained structural rebar. R04c lands.
key_beats.state_change: The mission advances: the wound's architecture is now legible as engineered human cost, not abstract containment. The scale of what Gavran's technique damaged is no longer theoretical.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers the mechanism through his body before his mind processes it — a vertigo-like drop in his center, a tightening of his throat. The Force around the wound is not a field; it is a cage built from twelve people's drained presence. The knowledge lands heavier than he expected.

key_beats.beat_description: Torin's reading of the same material lands as correction-not-violation — coherent, beautiful, dangerous. The logic is tight. The precedent is sound. The conclusion follows.
key_beats.state_change: Pressure escalates. Torin's rationalization deepens; the technique is no longer a war crime but a necessary correction, and the anchor system becomes not a prison but a structural solution to a structural problem.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's focus tightens on the argument's internal coherence. His head begins to nod — a small motion, almost unconscious. The seduction is in the logic's elegance, in how well it fits the evidence he has just understood in his body. Part of him wants Torin to be right.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera steps close enough to place her hand flat on the table between Torin and the artifact — a physical barrier, quiet and deliberate.
key_beats.state_change: The scene pivots. The common area's intellectual momentum breaks. Sera's presence becomes a counterweight.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben catches the motion of his own head nodding. He stops it. The awareness of his own susceptibility lands like a second shock — he was almost agreeing. Sera's hand on the table is not a gesture; it is a name without a name.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera pulls Ben into the corridor and speaks with her back to the common area door, her voice very quiet.
key_beats.state_change: The scene closes on private warning. Ben is isolated from the others' hearing. Sera names the argument's lineage without naming Gavran — she has heard this one before, from a man she followed into a war.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben braces for the weight of what Sera is about to say. The pattern is legible now — not just Torin's logic, but the shape of how that logic has moved through history, how it has justified catastrophe before. Sera doesn't say Gavran's name. She doesn't need to. Ben hears it anyway.

anti_patterns: Do not open with exposition about the Codex or the anchor system
Do not have Ben articulate his susceptibility aloud
Do not name Gavran in dialogue
Do not resolve the tension between Torin's logic and Ben's warning
Do not soften Sera's intervention with reassurance or warmth
Do not use diagnostic voice when describing the Force wound
Avoid arriving at clinical articulation of the wound's mechanism — keep it sensory and embodied
Do not describe the anchor system in engineering metaphors that distance the human cost
